editorial.blurb: Chubby Skewers brings authentic Chinese BBQ to Chicago with skewers that hit every note—char, seasoning, flavor—exactly the way real chuan'r should.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a weekday if you can; Saturday waits are long but worth it. Ask your server for ordering guidance on first visit, and note they're currently BYOB while awaiting their liquor license.
